title: Executive Functioning and Mental Health in Adolescent Kidney Transplant Candidates During the COVID-19 Pandemic.
authors: Kane-Grade FE, Glad D, Anzalone C, Evans MD, Kizilbash S, Gu L.
figures: Adolescent pretransplant candidates showed greater executive functioning difficulties and mental health concerns during the COVID‐19 pandemic, in comparison with their before pandemic cohort. However, there were no significant difference in these domains between the before and during pandemic groups in the preadolescent candidates.
Correlations between caregiver‐reported mental health concerns (depression, anxiety, aggression, and attention) and the global EF index were all higher than 0.7.
tables: Executive functioning and mental health based on age and pandemic era.
